style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: the camera tracks sideways along the bough every beat; the bough whips across frame and reverses at 0.90, 1.80, 3.15, 5.25 and 7.20, she rides it and slides along it, never still; the creditors leap in low arcs across frame and finish at the lens, never straight up; ONE sideways move per beat, never chained; new shot size each beat; her muzzle never under a third of frame, jaw visible; she stays on the bough, never runs at the camera on her feet
character: a wiry macaque in a grey waistcoat astride a whipping bough, exactly two arms, muzzle and jaw clear
second_characters: A SWARM of creditors in grey suits leaping up at her from below, ONE of them a shoulder from the lens every beat, crossing frame and hitting the glass; all of them moving
props: ONE carrying pole across her shoulders; ONE sack of pale jute roped to each end, same cloth and size; A SWARM of paper slips inside the sacks; ONE handful of iron weights in her fist
prop_continuity: the pole rides on her shoulders all clip, both sacks stay roped to its ends, the weights gone by 0.90
environment: a grove packed wall to wall with leaping creditors, swaying boughs and torn leaves close to the lens, a lit market street behind the trunks
light_events: white noon, shafts through the leaves sweeping her every beat, a hard rim on her muzzle

audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, even 4.45 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: GIR-ki, do-LOY, SLE-va, dol-GI, SPRA-va, i-po-TE-ka, tol-KAY-tes, ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PRO-sto, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON
audio.pacing: speech runs unbroken 0.00 to 7.20, first word at 0.00, no gap between beats; after 7.20 leaves, boots and paper fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: the whip of the bough, the roar of the grove, boots, paper

timeline.a: she hurls the weights past her muzzle at the lens, the near creditor crossing a shoulder away
her left shoulder drives the left sack across frame to the lens, a creditor leaping through the gap
her right shoulder drives the right sack to the lens the same way, another creditor clipping it mid-leap
she shoves a leaping creditor's shoulder aside, the bough whipping her across frame
she rides the bough down at the lens, both sacks carried forward level with each other
she yanks the left rope mid-swing, a jet of slips into the near creditor's face
she yanks the right rope mid-swing, the same jet of slips into the same creditor's face
she slides along the bough, the pole and both sacks sweeping the frame, a creditor ducking under
two creditors haul the bough across frame, her muzzle filling the glass
the bough whips her muzzle into the lens through the paper, jaw open, both sacks thrown at the glass

must_appear: the left sack opened at 5.25 and the right at 6.75 by the same yank, the same slips out of both; both sacks level at the lens at 4.05; nothing touches her before 7.20; every word spoken, the last by 7.20; jaw open on every syllable
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a rigid bough, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a wide or distant hero, standing bystanders, slow motion, letters, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, hands grabbing or carrying the hero before 7.20, extra limbs, multiple monkeys, scales, foreign accent
